id: title:EDsCODE:gate shadow runs on trino readiness

review.posthog_relevance: Adds warehouse translation readiness checks and query caching support, potentially relevant to PostHog's warehouse ingestion and HogQL query optimization.
review.reason: Adds eligibility and readiness checks for Duckgres shadow paths and warehouse translation, alongside shared utility functions for query hashing. P1.F4.H7 and P1.F8.H2 implement checks before proceeding with warehouse operations; P1.F11.H1 provides deterministic query hashing and Trino catalog availability checks. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The exact operational benefit and adoption status are not demonstrated; this is a code implementation without verified outcome or adoption data.
